Here, ut is the “true premium” that arises from transitory liquidity pressure.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The reported premium pi = p - NAV conflates a tradable shock to price (true premium u = p - v) with stale NAV. Madhavan's price-discovery share D = 1 - (sigma_u/sigma_pi)^2 is the variance fraction driven by the price leading a stale NAV, NOT by u: high D means the screen premium is mostly non-tradable staleness; low D means it is mostly the tradable true premium.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: True vs Reported Premium & the Price-Discovery Share
